newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles says Bartels resigns as ceo.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles says Bartels resigns as ceo.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Monday its managing director and chief executive officer Peter Bartels has resigned and will be replaced by Dennis Eck.
Bartels will leave Coles Myer and resign as a director on December 31, 1996, chairman Nobby Clark said. Eck will be appointed managing director and CEO effective January 1.

Clark said Coles Myer had been facing a situation in which he would retire as chairman and be replaced by Stan Wallis and Bartels would complete his contract as CEO almost simultaneously in July 1997. "Both Peter and the company agreed that this was not desirable and that it was in the best interests of the company to stagger the changes and achieve greater continuity."
